items.title: Create Your Account
items.description: Sign up with your email and shop name. No credit card needed — you get a 7-day free trial. Choose your business category (products or services) and you're ready to go.
steps: Go to keel.framestudio.co.ke and click 'Get Started'
Enter your email, shop name, and password
Select your business type — product-based or service-based
Pick your category (Clothing, Electronics, Salon, Laundry, etc.)
Complete the setup wizard with your store details

items.title: Add Your First Products
items.description: Populate your inventory with products or services. Add names, prices, stock quantities, and optional barcodes for quick scanning.
steps: Go to Inventory from the sidebar
Click 'Add Product' and fill in the name, price, and stock
Set a cost price to track profit margins
Optionally add barcode for scanner support (electronics/electricals)
For service businesses, go to Services instead

items.title: Log Your First Sale
items.description: Record sales as they happen. Keel automatically deducts stock and updates your revenue dashboard in real time.
steps: Go to Sales from the sidebar
Click 'Log Sale' and select a product
Enter quantity, total amount, and payment method (Cash, M-Pesa, etc.)
Optionally print a receipt for the customer
View the updated dashboard on the Overview page

items.title: Managing Products
items.description: Add, edit, and organise your products. Each product can have a name, price, stock quantity, cost price, category, barcode, and image.

items.title: Stock Adjustments
items.description: Manually adjust stock levels for damaged goods, returns, or corrections. Every adjustment is logged in Stock History for audit.

items.title: Low Stock Alerts
items.description: Set a low stock threshold in Settings → Notifications. Products below this threshold are highlighted in the sidebar and on the Overview dashboard.

items.title: Barcode Scanning
items.description: For electronics and electricals categories, use your phone camera to scan barcodes. Keel auto-fills product details when adding new items or finding products during sales.

items.title: Publishing to Your Website
items.description: Publish products from Inventory to your live website catalogue with one tap. Only available after setting up your website URL in Settings.

items.title: Logging Sales
items.description: Record every sale with product, quantity, amount, and payment method. Stock is deducted automatically.

items.title: Receipts
items.description: Print or share a detailed receipt for any sale. Receipts include shop name, date, items, amounts, and a custom footer message.

items.title: Payment Methods
items.description: Choose from Cash, M-Pesa, Bank, Card, or Other. Configure your default payment method in Settings → Preferences.

items.title: M-Pesa Reconciliation
items.description: Upload your M-Pesa statement CSV to automatically match payments with recorded sales. Available on the Finance page.

items.title: Tracking Expenses
items.description: Record business expenses with descriptions, amounts, categories, and payment methods. Filter and search your expense history.

items.title: Daily Revenue
items.description: View today's sales total and quantity broken down by payment method on the Finance page.

items.title: Profit & Loss
items.description: See your profit and loss as a bar chart with week or month toggle. Revenue, expenses, and net profit are calculated automatically.

items.title: Profit Margins per Product
items.description: View revenue, cost, profit, and margin percentage for each product that has been sold. Uses cost price data you set in Inventory.

items.title: Dashboard Overview
items.description: The Overview page shows today's sales, total products, low stock count, a 30-day sales chart, and your top-selling products.

items.title: Export Options
items.description: Export P&L reports as CSV or PDF for accounting or record-keeping.

items.title: Stock History
items.description: Every stock movement — sales, adjustments, restocks — is logged with timestamps and reasons. Searchable by product name.

items.title: Slow-Moving Stock
items.description: Identify products with low or no sales in the last 30 days to make informed restocking decisions.

items.title: Setting Up Your Website
items.description: Go to Settings → Store and enter your website URL. Once set, the Website tab unlocks with Banners, Business Info, Gallery, and Chat Widget sections.

items.title: Banners
items.description: Create promotional banners for your website — hero, sale, info, or alert types. Each banner can have an image, link, and sort order.

items.title: Business Info
items.description: Update your store name, phone, address, email, and business hours. These appear on your public website.

items.title: Gallery
items.description: Upload images of your shop, products, or workspace to build trust with website visitors.

items.title: Chat Widget
items.description: Enable a WhatsApp chat widget on your website so visitors can message you directly. Customise the welcome message, widget color, and position.

items.title: QR Codes
items.description: Generate QR codes for your products, website, or WhatsApp number. Print them for physical displays so customers can scan and browse.

items.title: Promotions & Badges
items.description: Mark products with sale prices or promotional badges directly in the Marketing page.

items.title: Print Catalogue
items.description: Generate a printable catalogue of your products for offline distribution.

items.title: Post Scheduler
items.description: Plan and schedule social media posts. Track likes, comments, and reach for each post.

items.title: AI Caption Generator
items.description: Generate product captions using AI. Available on Pro plan.

items.title: Creating Orders
items.description: For service businesses (laundry, salon, automotive, etc.), create orders with customer details, items, and notes.

items.title: Order Status Tracking
items.description: Move orders through statuses: Pending → In Progress → Ready → Completed. The Queue page shows all active orders.

items.title: Customer Profiles
items.description: Each customer gets a profile with their contact info, order history, and total spent. Access from Customers page.

items.title: Store Settings
items.description: Update your store name, currency symbol, theme (light/dark), website URL, WhatsApp number, and contact details.

items.title: Subscription
items.description: View your subscription status and expiry date. Renew through the Settings → Billing tab or from the lockout screen.

items.title: Profile
items.description: Manage your profile picture, display name, email, and password from the Profile page.

items.title: Data Export & Deletion
items.description: Export all your data as JSON from Settings → Data. You can also delete individual records or wipe all shop data.

items.title: Website not showing
items.description: Make sure you've set your website URL in Settings → Store. Products need to be published from Inventory to appear on your site.

items.title: Payment not going through
items.description: Ensure you have a stable internet connection. If Paystack fails, try again after a few minutes. Contact support if the issue persists.

items.title: Can't log in
items.description: Check your email and password. Use 'Forgot Password' on the login page to reset. If you recently signed up, check your email for the confirmation link.

items.title: Data not loading
items.description: Refresh the page or log out and back in. If the issue continues, check your internet connection or contact support.
